propositions: MCP discovery list tools (list_tickets, ready_tickets, search) have no payload size bound and exceed client budgets, causing transport closures on large stores with no structured error signal

The payload budget must measure wire bytes post-model-validation and post-js_safe_result quoting, not raw reducer dicts, because serialization and model defaults add 178% and FastMCP emits results twice (both structuredContent and per-row content blocks), causing under-estimates that pass oversized payloads

The lean projection omitted only description/comments but left 88% of payload as base64 signature material (authorship_ledger, attestations, signature, keyring); extending LEAN_OMITTED_FIELDS to drop all four achieves 9x size reduction and enables ordinary queries to fit the 90,000-byte budget

Refused oversize lists must return structured RebarError with error_code=response_too_large carrying tool-specific remedies (list_tickets names its six filters, ready_tickets names next_batch since it accepts no filters, search names field predicates) so callers can distinguish budget overflow from server failure
